headline: Governor rejects delaying full implementation of the Alabama Literacy Act
snippet: Ivey vetoed SB94 delaying third-grade retention, calling delay 'hasty and premature.'

headline: 'VETO': Governor Kay Ivey takes strong stand for Alabama's children
snippet: Yellowhammer framed veto as strong stand for children's literacy.

headline: Ivey vetoes bill aimed at delaying Alabama Literacy Act
snippet: Vetoed despite passing Senate 23-9 and House 68-27.

headline: Senate passes delayed implementation of Alabama literacy program
snippet: Senate passed to delay promotion policy mandating grade retention for low readers.
